paper.title_en: Generalized eigenstate thermalization beyond leading order in 2D large $c$ CFTs
paper.abstract_en: We develop a Fock-space formulation that reduces expectation values of vacuum-family quasi-primaries in quantum Korteweg--de Vries (qKdV) eigenstates to a free-bosonic problem, and employ it to test the generalized eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (GETH) in 2D conformal field theories with a large central charge. We prove that the first two qKdV charges $Q_1$ and $Q_3$ lift all degeneracies except along at most countably many curves in the $(c,\,Δ)$ plane, where $c$ is the central charge and $Δ$ denotes the highest weight of the conformal family, so that the full-qKdV simultaneous eigenstates are unambiguously determined by $Q_1$ and $Q_3$. Based on this, a comprehensive toolkit for testing GETH within the scope of vacuum-family observables, i.e. equating qKdV eigenstates and thermal states of the generalized Gibbs ensemble in the sense of expectation values of vacuum-family local observables, is provided in this paper. We argue that GETH is satisfied when the infinite tower of qKdV charges is considered. A more restrictive form of the GETH, namely that all expectations of local observables of a definite level should be expressible in terms of the first few qKdV charges, is directly falsified at subleading order in the large-$c$ expansion. Specifically, at levels 6 and 8 in the vacuum family, expectation values of quasi-primaries in simultaneous eigenstates of the qKdV charges are not determined by any finite number of the lowest-index qKdV charges. The question of whether additional microscopic information about the eigenstate is required is left for future work.
